_comment: Catalyst template — Enshrouded dedicated server (Windows-only game, run through GE-Proton). Fixes the 1.0 launch failure where the game exits within a second because the container's bundled Proton is too old for the Steamworks SDK 1.0 requires. Hand-maintained Catalyst egg (PTDL_v2 format, importable by Pterodactyl-style panels).
name: Enshrouded (Catalyst)
author: catalyst
description:
Enshrouded dedicated server — a survival, crafting and Action-RPG game set in a sprawling voxel continent.

Enshrouded ships a WINDOWS-ONLY dedicated server (Steam app 2278520, oslist=windows), so this template runs it through GE-Proton. That detail is what makes the stock egg break: ghcr.io/ptero-eggs/steamcmd:proton (built 2026-06-22, Debian 12 / glibc 2.36) ships GE-Proton10-34, whose lsteamclient shim implements SteamUtils008/009/010 but NOT SteamUtils011. Enshrouded 1.0 (2026-10-15) requires SteamUtils011, so the server dies during Steamworks init — before it ever writes enshrouded_server.log. The visible symptom is a bare exit-code-1 crash loop with `tail: cannot open './logs/enshrouded_server.log'`.

This template pins ghcr.io/ptero-eggs/steamcmd:ubuntu_24.04 (Ubuntu 24.04 / glibc 2.39, ships libvulkan1 and Xvfb) and installs GE-Proton11-9 at install time (its lsteamclient exports SteamUtils011, 258 references). Xvfb is started before Proton because a headless Wine/Proton prefix needs an X display.

GE-Proton11-9 is a glibc-2.38+ build, so it CANNOT run on the bookworm-based steamcmd:proton image — the distro, not just the Proton version, is part of the fix. Verified end-to-end on Catalyst: server reaches `[Session] 'HostOnline' (up)!` and listens on UDP 15637.
startup: mkdir -p .steam/sdk64; ln -sf /home/container/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/steamclient.so; export STEAM_COMPAT_CLIENT_INSTALL_PATH=/home/container/steamcmd; export STEAM_COMPAT_DATA_PATH=/home/container/proton-prefix; export STEAM_COMPAT_APP_ID=2278520; export PROTON_USE_XALIA=0; export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml=;dbghelp=n,b"; mkdir -p /home/container/proton-prefix; Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 -nolisten tcp >/dev/null 2>&1 & sleep 2; export DISPLAY=:99; rm -f ./logs/enshrouded_server.log; /home/container/proton-ge/proton run ./enshrouded_server.exe & ENS_PID=$! ; sleep 3; tail -c0 -F ./logs/enshrouded_server.log --pid=$ENS_PID

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Enshrouded (Catalyst) install script — Catalyst template
#
# Downloads the game (Steam app 2278520, Windows depot) and a GE-Proton build
# new enough for the Steamworks SDK Enshrouded 1.0 requires.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server (Catalyst symlinks /mnt/server -> /data)

set -o pipefail

PROTON_VERSION="${ENS_PROTON_VERSION:-GE-Proton11-9}"
PROTON_DIR="/mnt/server/proton-ge"
STEAMCMD_DIR="/mnt/server/steamcmd"

if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo "steam user is not set, using anonymous user."
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

# ── SteamCMD ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
mkdir -p "${STEAMCMD_DIR}" /mnt/server/steamapps
cd /tmp || exit 1
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o steamcmd_linux.tar.gz \
    https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz \
    || { echo "ERROR: failed to download steamcmd"; exit 1; }
tar -xzf steamcmd_linux.tar.gz -C "${STEAMCMD_DIR}"
cd "${STEAMCMD_DIR}" || exit 1

# SteamCMD refuses to run as root unless the tree is root-owned.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

# ── Game files (Windows depot — the dedicated server is Windows-only) ─────
echo "Installing Enshrouded dedicated server (app ${SRCDS_APPID})..."
./steamcmd.sh \
    +force_install_dir /mnt/server \
    +login "${STEAM_USER}" "${STEAM_PASS}" "${STEAM_AUTH}" \
    +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows \
    +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID}" \
    $([[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID}" ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}") \
    $([[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}") \
    ${INSTALL_FLAGS} \
    $([[ "${VALIDATE}" == "1" ]] && printf %s 'validate') \
    +quit

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/enshrouded_server.exe ]; then
    echo "ERROR: enshrouded_server.exe was not installed — the server cannot start."
    echo "Check the Steam credentials and reinstall."
    exit 1
fi

# ── Steam client libraries (Steamworks init needs these) ─────────────────
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux32/steamclient.so" /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux64/steamclient.so" /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

# ── GE-Proton ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Enshrouded 1.0 needs SteamUtils011 from lsteamclient, which GE-Proton only
# gained in the 11.x series. Anything older dies in Steamworks init.
# The version file reads "<buildid> GE-Proton11-9".
if [ -x "${PROTON_DIR}/proton" ] && grep -q "${PROTON_VERSION}$" "${PROTON_DIR}/version" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "${PROTON_VERSION} already installed, skipping download."
else
    rm -rf "${PROTON_DIR}"
    mkdir -p "${PROTON_DIR}"
    echo "Downloading ${PROTON_VERSION} (this is a ~560 MB tarball)..."
    curl -fSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o /tmp/proton.tar.gz \
        "https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/releases/download/${PROTON_VERSION}/${PROTON_VERSION}-x86_64.tar.gz" \
        || { echo "ERROR: failed to download ${PROTON_VERSION}"; exit 1; }
    tar -xzf /tmp/proton.tar.gz -C "${PROTON_DIR}" --strip-components=1
    rm -f /tmp/proton.tar.gz
fi

if [ ! -x "${PROTON_DIR}/proton" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: ${PROTON_DIR}/proton is missing after extraction."
    exit 1
fi

# Fail loudly at install time rather than with an unexplained crash loop on
# the first start: GE-Proton 11 needs libvulkan.so.1 and glibc >= 2.38.
if ! ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'libvulkan\.so\.1'; then
    echo "ERROR: libvulkan.so.1 is missing from this image."
    echo "${PROTON_VERSION} cannot start without it. Use the template's"
    echo "default image (ghcr.io/ptero-eggs/steamcmd:ubuntu_24.04)."
    exit 1
fi
GLIBC_MINOR="$(ldd --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | cut -d. -f2)"
if [ -z "${GLIBC_MINOR}" ] || [ "${GLIBC_MINOR}" -lt 38 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: ${PROTON_VERSION} needs glibc 2.38 or newer; this image has $(ldd --version 2>/dev/null | head -1)."
    echo "Use the template's default image (ghcr.io/ptero-eggs/steamcmd:ubuntu_24.04)."
    exit 1
fi

# ── Default configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/enshrouded_server.json ]; then
    echo "Writing a default enshrouded_server.json..."
    cat > /mnt/server/enshrouded_server.json <<'JSON'
{
    "enableTextChat": false,
    "enableVoiceChat": false,
    "gameSettingsPreset": "Default",
    "ip": "0.0.0.0",
    "logDirectory": "./logs",
    "name": "My Enshrouded Server",
    "queryPort": 15637,
    "saveDirectory": "./savegame",
    "slotCount": 16,
    "tags": [],
    "userGroups": [
        { "name": "Admin",   "password": "ChangeMe1", "canKickBan": true,  "canAccessInventories": true, "canEditWorld": true, "canEditBase": true, "canExtendBase": true, "reservedSlots": 0 },
        { "name": "Friend",  "password": "ChangeMe2", "canKickBan": false, "canAccessInventories": true, "canEditWorld": true, "canEditBase": true, "canExtendBase": true, "reservedSlots": 0 },
        { "name": "Guest",   "password": "ChangeMe3", "canKickBan": false, "canAccessInventories": false, "canEditWorld": false, "canEditBase": false, "canExtendBase": false, "reservedSlots": 3 },
        { "name": "Visitor", "password": "ChangeMe4", "canKickBan": false, "canAccessInventories": false, "canEditWorld": false, "canEditBase": false, "canExtendBase": false, "reservedSlots": 0 }
    ],
    "bannedAccounts": [],
    "voiceChatMode": "Proximity"
}
JSON
else
    echo "enshrouded_server.json already exists, keeping it."
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server/savegame /mnt/server/logs
chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/server 2>/dev/null || true

echo "Enshrouded install complete."

variables.name: GE-Proton Version
variables.description: GE-Proton release used to run the Windows dedicated server. Must be 11-x or newer: Enshrouded 1.0 needs SteamUtils011, which the lsteamclient shim only gained in the 11.x series. Change the value and reinstall the server to upgrade.

variables.name: [SERVER] Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server list and on the Steam server browser.

variables.name: [SERVER] Max Players
variables.description: Number of player slots. The server accepts up to 16.

variables.name: [USER GROUP] 'Admin' Group Password
variables.description: Password for the Admin user group (full base and world edit rights). Use 8+ characters; Enshrouded rejects purely numeric passwords.

variables.name: [USER GROUP] 'Friend' Group Password
variables.description: Password for the Friend user group (build and edit rights, cannot kick or ban). Use 8+ characters; Enshrouded rejects purely numeric passwords.

variables.name: [USER GROUP] 'Guest' Group Password
variables.description: Password for the Guest user group (join and play, no edit rights). Use 8+ characters; Enshrouded rejects purely numeric passwords.

variables.name: [USER GROUP] 'Visitor' Group Password
variables.description: Password for the Visitor user group (read-only access). Use 8+ characters; Enshrouded rejects purely numeric passwords.

variables.name: [STEAM] Steam App ID
variables.description: Enshrouded dedicated server app id. Do not change.

variables.name: [SYSTEM] Windows Install
variables.description: Enshrouded's dedicated server only ships Windows depots, so this must stay enabled. Do not change.

variables.name: [SYSTEM] Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server files from Steam before each start. Leave enabled so 1.0 hotfixes are picked up automatically.

variables.name: [SYSTEM] Validate
variables.description: Run a full Steam file validation on the next start. Slow (re-verifies ~8 GB) but repairs a corrupted install.
